author: olpipi
title: Debian Packages job fails - security.ubuntu.com repository no longer signed
signature: the repository security ubuntu com jammy security inrelease is no longer signed|Network

failed_jobs.name: Debian Packages / Debian Packages
failed_jobs.symptom: apt-get update fails: security.ubuntu.com jammy-security InRelease returns HTTP 520 and is reported as no longer signed

key_errors:
2026-11-19T12:39:08.1092516Z Err:11 http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu jammy-security InRelease

root_cause: The 'Install debian packages & check conflicts' step runs apt-get update, which fetches the jammy-security InRelease file from security.ubuntu.com. The Cloudflare-fronted mirror returned HTTP 520 (an upstream/edge server error, not a content signing problem); apt then reports the repository release file as unreachable, and because it could not fetch a fresh signed release at all apt treats this transient fetch failure as 'no longer signed' and aborts with exit code 100. This is an external Ubuntu/Canonical CDN outage/edge error unrelated to the PR's source changes (prefetch logic in src/common/util and the GPU plugin); none of the PR's changed files are touched by this job.
reproduction_steps: N/A (depends on transient availability of http://security.ubuntu.com at the time of the run). Locally: run `apt-get update` inside the same Ubuntu 22.04 container image used by job_debian_packages.yml during an outage window to reproduce the 520 from security.ubuntu.com.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Debian Packages' job (or the whole run) once security.ubuntu.com recovers; this is not a code issue in PR #39784.

Consider adding `Acquire::Retries` and exponential backoff around apt-get update in job_debian_packages.yml (similar to the 'Set apt retries' step already present) to better tolerate transient 5xx responses from Ubuntu mirrors.

Optionally route jammy-security through the same Azure mirror substitution already used for other Ubuntu repos ('Switch Ubuntu APT sources to Azure mirrors' step) if that mirror reliably serves jammy-security without routing through security.ubuntu.com's Cloudflare edge.
prevention_strategies: Harden the Debian Packages job's apt-get update against upstream mirror outages: increase apt retry/backoff settings, and/or ensure the jammy-security repository is also redirected to the Azure mirror set (as already done for the main Ubuntu archive) so a single external CDN's edge errors cannot fail the merge-queue run.
historical_context: A related but distinct Network-category pattern exists in the knowledge base (signature_hash e65acb49deb19d88, 'Debian Packages job fails - Unable to connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com', 1 prior occurrence on 2026-08-19 for PR #37338) for the same job failing to reach the Azure mirror. This is the first recorded occurrence of the specific 'no longer signed' / HTTP 520 failure mode against security.ubuntu.com itself.
